discovery-c822b0380a741371fa55d21fd7ad23.title: Wood Shop Tour
discovery-c822b0380a741371fa55d21fd7ad23.description: Watch master craftsmen handcrafting custom solid hardwood furniture. At George's, you’ll be transported to a different world where furniture is made by hand. Skilled craftsmen take a solid piece of cherry, oak, maple or walnut and carve it into furniture that is a functional work of art for your home. Each piece created is one-of-a kind, signed and dated by the artisan. Enjoy watching handmade furniture being built, and shop in our showroom. Woodshop Tour Hours Mon-Fri, 9 a.m.-2 p.m. Showroom hours Mon-Sat 9am–5pm. Our tour begins in our showroom where we learn about the 50+ year history of Georges furniture, from hobby to business, what makes George's different from other furniture stores, and the amazing ability of our extension tables. (Tables start at 5 ft and extend to 12+ feet with ease.) then proceed to our wood working shop where the craftsmen select the wood looking at the grain, using basic saws, jointers, sanders and planers. Next, we see the furniture be stained and protected with a water-resistant finish. Finally we see our showroom with our 21-foot dining table and our bedroom furniture. After our wood shop tour, people look at furniture a whole new way. It is very informative and impactful. Monday-Friday weekly from 9-2pm year round
discovery-c822b0380a741371fa55d21fd7ad23.categories: Classes & Workshops, Family Fun, Heritage & History, Shopping

Skilled craftsmen take a solid piece of cherry, oak, maple or walnut and carve it into furniture that is a functional work of art for your home. Each piece created is one-of-a kind, signed and dated by the artisan. Enjoy watching handmade furniture being built, and shop in our showroom. Woodshop Tour Hours Mon-Fri, 9 a.m.-2 p.m. Showroom hours Mon-Sat 9am–5pm. Our tour begins in our showroom where we learn about the 50+ year history of Georges furniture, from hobby to business, what makes George's different from other furniture stores, and the amazing ability of our extension tables. (Tables start at 5 ft and extend to 12+ feet with ease.) then proceed to our wood working shop where the craftsmen select the wood looking at the grain, using basic saws, jointers, sanders and planers. Next, we see the furniture be stained and protected with a water-resistant finish. Finally we see our showroom with our 21-foot dining table and our bedroom furniture. After our wood shop tour, people look at furniture a whole new way. It is very informative and impactful. Monday-Friday weekly from 9-2pm year round
occurrences.categories: Classes & Workshops, Family Fun, Heritage & History, Shopping
occurrences.location: Georges Furniture wood shop, 9 Reichs Church Rd, Marietta, PA 17547

discovery-2a9ba2e6724adcbc1f1429f3a875c8.title: Watercolor Club
discovery-2a9ba2e6724adcbc1f1429f3a875c8.description: Friday afternoon is a great time to set your intention for a grounded and restful weekend. What better way to do it than with an hour of play and relaxation with other friendly creatives.Watercolor Club low-pressure, watercolor play time for adults. Come as you are, grab your favorite supplies, and explore color, gesture, and mood. I’m on hand to answer any questions you have and provide some tips and tricks, all to help you loosen up and collaborate with the medium. Absolutely no experience needed.We meet at WestArt where you can grab some coffee or whatever suits your fancy, settle in and enjoy the vibes while being part of a vibrant and growing community of artists. Bring your favorite materials or show up empty handed, either way, I’ve got you covered.What to expect:Watercolor club is a place to explore the magic and wonder of watercolor while honing your skills at the same time. No experience necessary. If you’ve always wanted to paint with watercolor but find it frustrating, this is the place for you. If you’ve been painting with watercolor for years but want to loosen up, this is the place for you. No matter where you are with your artistic practice (or lack thereof) you’ll feel right at home.What to bring:I supply materials, but you are welcome to bring any of your own.All levels welcome. just bring yourself and a willingness to play. I hope to see you there! Every Friday afternoon

discovery-708963cd0f7444bf631e3adc4a841f.title: Chief Uncas Sunset Cruise
discovery-708963cd0f7444bf631e3adc4a841f.description: Watch the Sunset over the Susquehanna! 1.5 hour Sunset Cruises give small groups (up to 16 passengers) the chance to roam the historic Chief Uncas for a personalized relaxing evening experience. Bring aboard food and B.Y.O.B. alcoholic beverages to enjoy as the Chief Uncas silently cruises under the setting sun. Store your cold drinks in the vintage ice box and use the boat’s Bluetooth speakers to play your favorite music. A knowledgeable crew member is aboard as your guide to answer questions or give a tour of the river. The perfect experience for a date night or fun time with friends! Sunset Cruises depart from the Zimmerman Center dock on Fridays and Saturdays during SNHA's Boat Tour Season. View the schedule to see cruise availability. Departure time changes depending on the summer and fall season. What's included 1.5 hour evening cruise at Sunset bring aboard food and drinks freely roam and explore the historic 112-year-old tour boat have a personal boat tour by tour guide on board bring aboard BYOB alcoholic beverages play music on the bluetooth speaker system Ticket Cost Tickets cost $50 per person. Due to popularity, advance reservations are advised! The cost of each ticket goes directly toward care, maintenance, storage, and tour operations of the Chief Uncas. Passenger Guidelines Passengers must be capable of navigating the boat ramp, dock, and boarding the Chief Uncas. Passengers must navigate a staircase of 3 metal grated stairs with handrail to reach the height of the boat’s entrance. Then passengers must navigate the 3 step ladder into the boat with assistance of handrails. SNHA's Crew and Captain are always present to provide additional assistance with boarding. Per US Coastguard recommendation children must be at least 6 months old to experience a tour aboard the Chief Uncas. SNHA reserves the right to deny service to individuals or groups in the interest of their own safety or the safety of other passengers, and to any person whose behavior is unacceptable, intrusive, or dangerous to other persons. Every Friday and Saturday evening

Due to popularity, advance reservations are advised! The cost of each ticket goes directly toward care, maintenance, storage, and tour operations of the Chief Uncas. Passenger Guidelines Passengers must be capable of navigating the boat ramp, dock, and boarding the Chief Uncas. Passengers must navigate a staircase of 3 metal grated stairs with handrail to reach the height of the boat’s entrance. Then passengers must navigate the 3 step ladder into the boat with assistance of handrails. SNHA's Crew and Captain are always present to provide additional assistance with boarding. Per US Coastguard recommendation children must be at least 6 months old to experience a tour aboard the Chief Uncas. discovery-afe8b5dfbb3338f5ffbc3f6ae43f25.title: One A-Chord Community Choir Presents The Gift
discovery-afe8b5dfbb3338f5ffbc3f6ae43f25.description: One A-Chord Community Choir Presents The Gift A Free Community Christmas Concert — Saturday November 28 at 6:00 pm and Sunday, November 29 at 4 p.m. Join One A-Chord Community Choir for The Gift, a joyful Christmas worship concert celebrating the birth of Jesus through powerful choral music, unity, and praise! This free community event begins at 6 p.m. on Saturday, November 28 at 6pm and again on Sunday November 29 at 4pm. Get ready to sing along to a wide variety of styles, genres, and time periods of corporate worship, including traditional and contemporary. Experience an evening filled with inspiring harmonies, heartfelt worship, and praise together to King Jesus. About One A-Chord One A-Chord is a vibrant community choir made up this season of 120 local singers from over 50 different churches—uniting believers of all ages and denominations. Known for their passionate and contagious joy, the choir has performed at churches, retirement homes, and community events such as National Day of Prayer, and more! Their simple mission is powerful and unifying: to bring the community together in one accord—lifting voices in praise to King Jesus. What to Expect Free Admission – Everyone is welcome! Engaging Worship – Sing along with displayed lyrics throughout the evening. Variety of Styles – Choral music from several time periods, including classics and modern worship songs. Family-Friendly Atmosphere – A meaningful event for all generations. Schedule – Concert begins 15-minute intermission after the first 45 minutes Concludes A freewill offering will be received to support the ongoing ministry of One A-Chord that sings to bring us together in worship. Learn More About the Choir One A-Chord will be sharing “The Gift” at several venues this season! If you can’t make the Manheim concert, visit oneachordministries.org to see their full schedule and find another concert near you this Christmas! Visit oneachordministries.org to learn more about the choir, bring your group, or to book an event

discovery-8a9f3b0d40bc9bf85f30254e475a48.description: Visit Lancaster City is collaborating with LancoHunts to host a Small Business Saturday Scavenger Hunt! Shoppers can visit participating retail businesses, solve clue, and get entered to win BIG prizes! How to Participate: Visit participating Lancaster City shops on Saturday, November 28. Scan the QR code at each shop to reveal a clue. Solve the clue to earn a raffle entry (take a selfie at the location for a bonus entry!). Play right on your phone with LancoHunts. No app download needed! Play, earn entries, and win prizes! Winners will be randomly selected a few days after the hunt. Participation is FREE!

Prepare to be whisked away into a wondrous winter wonderland, where the magic of the holiday season comes alive amid a realm of fantastical characters, mouthwatering delicacies, and exquisite beverages. Doors Open: 11 AM Starts: 11 AM Ends: 4:30 PM Tickets are date-specific and non-refundable.Yuletide at the Faire is a rain or shine event.

discovery-525b5ecbd34d5b4ce84d1b96961ad0.title: Photos with Krampus at Lancaster Cemetery
discovery-525b5ecbd34d5b4ce84d1b96961ad0.description: Lancaster Cemetery is offering its " Photos with Krampus" fundraiser on Saturday, November 28, 2026 and December 5, 2026 between 12pm-3pm. Stop by Lancaster Cemetery for holiday photos with Krampus, a horned creature who punishes those who misbehave at Christmastime! Why not have a unique photo for this year's holiday card? Suggested donation is $10 for a few poses with (or without!) your pal Krampus. Visitors should bring their own cameras. Volunteers will be on site to assist. This event is first-come, first-serve. Photo set-up may be outdoors this year. Proceeds go toward maintenance of Lancaster city's historic Victorian cemetery. Leashed and well-behaved pets are welcome. All proceeds benefit The Lancaster Cemetery 501c13 non-profit in preserving, maintaining, and promoting the historic grounds and caretaker house.

discovery-c6dc25340da7b335612ac9823bb677.title: Terre Hill Christmas in the Park
discovery-c6dc25340da7b335612ac9823bb677.description: Join us as we kick off the holiday season at Terre Hill’s annual Christmas in the Park! This fun filled event, December 4-6 and 11-13 from 5:00-8:30pm, includes 100+ handmade lighted displays and hundreds of thousands of lights along our signature Christmas themed walking trail, visits with Santa, craft vendors, kids’ activities, ice sculpture carving, live music, and more! Bring your appetite and enjoy a variety of tasty treats from our food pavilion and local vendors. Stop by each night for special events and visit with other community organizations from the area. General admission is free, some activities (including Trail admission) require a small fee. Proceeds benefit the Terre Hill Park. For more information and the full schedule, visit www.terrehillpark.com. Dec. 4, 5, 6, 11, 12, 13, 2026 from 5:00 PM to 8:30 PM

discovery-d07262b193821e46919702b74fb147.title: Krampus Photos as Lancaster Cemtery
discovery-d07262b193821e46919702b74fb147.description: Lancaster Cemetery is offering its " Photos with Krampus" fundraiser on Saturday, November 28, 2026 and Saturday, December 5, 2026 between 12pm-3pm. Stop by Lancaster Cemetery for holiday photos with Krampus, a horned creature who punishes those who misbehave at Christmastime! Why not have a unique photo for this year's holiday card? Suggested donation is $10 for a few poses with (or without!) your pal Krampus. Visitors should bring their own cameras. Volunteers will be on site to assist. This event is first-come, first-serve. Photo set-up may be outdoors this year. Proceeds go toward maintenance of Lancaster city's historic Victorian cemetery. Leashed and well-behaved pets are welcome. All proceeds benefit The Lancaster Cemetery 501c13 non-profit in preserving, maintaining, and promoting the historic grounds and caretaker house.

discovery-795fff7e3e31694143c66dddfc43e7.title: The Christmas Market at Flinchbaugh Farms
discovery-795fff7e3e31694143c66dddfc43e7.description: The Christmas Market at Flinchbaugh Farms Saturday, December 5 (10a-4p) & Sunday, December 6 (11a-3p) – held rain or shine We are pleased to announce The Christmas Market at Flinchbaugh Farms – a festive outdoor market experience to replicate the famous European Christmas Markets. Guests will find enchanting local artistic wares, hot mulled cider, wine, and brews and Christmas music by a toasty warm fire pit. The friendly alpaca family from Alpacas of York will be present, musical and dance entertainment alongside flavorful food concessions greet our guests. Santa will visit with kiddos both days 11a-2p! Admission is free. Come prepared to enjoy the outdoor atmosphere, good food, music and local artisans! 2026 Christmas Market Food & Drink Vendors • Auntie Anne’s • Perry Pizza • Daddy Mac • Lori’s Lattes • 7 Spices Doner Kebab • Sunny Side Sweets • Wine: Benigna’s Creek Vineyard & Winery • Wine: Cardinal Hollow Winery 2026 Entertainment Schedule Saturday & Sunday: • Photos with Santa • Meet the Alpaca’s of York • Face Painting by The California Boys • Photos Opps at the Farm – on your own • Live Music by Jennifer Stella • Fire Pits Saturday – only: Oh! Gills Irish Dance Team - Performance at 1:30p Sunday – only: Central York Holiday Ensembles – Performance at 12p 2026 Local Artisans – announced soon Saturday and Sunday 12/5 (11-4) & 12/6 (11-3)

discovery-dbbde449f244a124cfccf16f17cda3.title: Joshua at Sight & Sound
discovery-dbbde449f244a124cfccf16f17cda3.description: From the banks of the Jordan River to the towering walls of Jericho, JOSHUA is a miraculous adventure for the whole family. Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their new-found freedom in an unforgiving wilderness. When Joshua is called to replace Moses as their faithful leader, tensions mount in the midst of dwindling supplies and approaching armies. With one last fortified city standing between the Israelites and the Promised Land, unexpected help emerges from behind enemy lines and Joshua’s trust in God’s plan is put to the ultimate test.Experience one of the most redemptive stories of the Bible as it comes to life in this brand-new original stage production from Sight & Sound Theatres.
discovery-dbbde449f244a124cfccf16f17cda3.location: Sight & Sound Theatre, 300 Hartman Bridge Road, Ronks, PA 17572

discovery-eafff1c725a2a21965912f6285e750.title: Living the Experience
discovery-eafff1c725a2a21965912f6285e750.description: Living the Experience is a spiritual, interactive reenactment of the Underground railroad. Patrons get a chance to step inside the shoes of Africans seeking their freedom in the 1800's in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. The production is the first Underground Railroad reenactment in Central Pennsylvania and has been sharing the story for 27 years. Each includes our reenactment, a southern style meal and access to local vendors on site. At our October 4th production you will also get a chance to meet award winning storyteller and former Jeopardy! cast member, Cheryl Farrell. She will be explaining how the Historical Bethel A.M.E. Church was featured on the popular game show and the importance of storytelling in the African heritage. Ticket sales end 1 week before each production. Groups of 35 or more may reserve a different date upon request. Please contact us for more information. Immerse yourself into history like never before. Come Live the Experience! This event happens every 1st Saturday

discovery-fee095ac961dcbbd2807c0cf659db5.title: Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour
discovery-fee095ac961dcbbd2807c0cf659db5.description: This walking tour is the perfect combination of History & Breakfast! Both history enthusiasts and foodies will enjoy this fun experience.Walk around the city of Lancaster with a local historian from Unique Lancaster Experiences. Our tour starts during the most important meal of the day. Learn about the interesting history of America's oldest inland City.Where: Downtown LancasterWhen 9am-11amDistance: Walking is an approximate 5-6 block circleKick off the tour with your choice of coffee or tea from a local coffee shop. You'll eat farm to table breakfast sandwiches made by an Amish Family. Have a vegetarian in the group? We will also accommodate those diets. This isn't your ordinary history tour. Engage in lively dialogues in a small group environment during this Lancaster walking tour. Discover fascinating facts about Lancaster's settlement, Market History, architecture, and more! We've curated five stops along the route to enjoy a variety of breakfast foods including Italian pastries and Netherlands stroopwafels.We offer special rates for private groups at Experiencelancasterpa.com

discovery-3821df6a2d7d232940bbee71cc4c17.title: Strasburg Holiday Home Tour
discovery-3821df6a2d7d232940bbee71cc4c17.description: Get in the Christmas spirit, enjoy historic homes, and get some ideas for decorating your own! The Strasburg Heritage Society’s 15th annual Holiday Home Tour will take place on Saturday, December 5, 2025 from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM, regardless of the weather. We have eight festively-decorated homes lined up. The homes on this year’s tour are all at least a century old, and some are much more. Half of the homes will be in town, within easy walking distance of each other, while the other half showcase wonderful properties all around the Strasburg vicinity. At our Event Center (First Presbyterian Church, 101 S. Decatur Street), tour tickets, lunch, craft vendors, and fresh holiday greens will be available. You are welcome to visit the Event Center even if you don’t purchase a ticket for the tour. Tickets will cost $30 on the day of the tour, but can be purchased anytime from November 7 to December 4 for $25. Advance tickets can be purchased in person at Main Street Antiques (2 W. Main St.) or Speckled Hen Coffee (141 E. Main St.), as well as online at StrasburgHeritageSociety.org under the Events tab. Once

discovery-4d9f015a0662bc4516c3638ebe93ef.description: The Heritage Chorale of Lancaster presents its Winter 2026 concert program: “What Sweeter Music” — based on the work by composer John Rutter. Join us as we celebrate our 32nd year of singing with a program of songs chosen by Artistic Director Barry L. Sawyer, accompanied by pianist Jordan Groh: Ave Maria by Anton Bruckner, Glow by Eric Whitacre, Hodie Christus Natus Est by Luca Marenzio, The Christmas Song by Mel Torme, El Rorro by Jeffrey Van and a host of traditional songs of the season!

discovery-1725f67545e5d7055535487f84db78.title: Christmas at the Cloister
discovery-1725f67545e5d7055535487f84db78.description: A Night of Christmas Music and Readings Monday & Tuesday, December 7 & 8 Performances at 6:00 PM & 7:30 PM each night Experience Christmas at the Cloister, a cherished “Lessons and Carols” program held in the historic 1741 Meetinghouse at the Ephrata Cloister. The event will be held on Monday, December 7, and Tuesday, December 8, with two performances offered each evening at 6:00pm and 7:30pm. This annual celebration will feature the story of Christmas as told through Scriptural readings, holiday music by the Ephrata Cloister Chorus, and carols for all to sing together. Guest musicians will also perform from the balcony. The evening will conclude with light refreshments including hot mulled cider, hot chocolate, and cookies in the Visitor Center auditorium. Seating is limited, and advance tickets are required for entry. No tickets will be sold at the door.

discovery-ebd93eb3fc4064849da654cd549495.title: Snowshoe Hares in Pennsylvania
discovery-ebd93eb3fc4064849da654cd549495.description: Snowshoe hares are a truly unique and elusive wildlife resource in Pennsylvania. One of about 20 species in the entire world that transitions to white in winter to camouflage with snow, the snowshoe hare appears to be in decline in Pennsylvania. The Game Commission to working to better understand how they can benefit this species through management and conservation.

discovery-74c29e8561014d8f221988cd15c4c9.title: Annual Christmas Candlelight Tours
discovery-74c29e8561014d8f221988cd15c4c9.description: Join us for this beloved annual event as we celebrate America 250, Lititz 270, and Lititz Historical Foundation’s 65th anniversaries! Two very merry nights! Our popular Annual Christmas Candlelight Tour is back, and this time, will take place over two nights! What better way to get into the holiday spirit than to visit Lititz, Pennsylvania. On December 12th and 13th, the Lititz Historical Foundation will hold its Annual Christmas Candlelight Tour. Guests will receive a guided tour of the 1792 Johannes Mueller House and will learn the story of Mueller and his family as well as history and customs of the early Moravian community of Lititz during the 18th century. Tours depart every 15 minutes and run from 5-8pm each evening. While you’re there, be sure to visit the Lititz Museum for holiday refreshments and to shop our gift shop for a tremendous selection of items! For ticket holders, we’ll also be offering a 10% discount in our gift shop on both evenings. Tickets are $12 per person and can be purchased below. Hurry! This event always sells out! Grab your tickets here: https://historicalhappenings67...

Enjoy an evening featuring award-winning magician Erick Hershey of Country Conjuring Magic, performing at 5:30 p.m.! Families can also enjoy cookie decorating, an interactive nativity, snacks, and plenty of Christmas fun. FREE and open to all ages! A love offering is welcome. Bring your family, invite your neighbors, and celebrate the magic, hope, and joy of Christmas with us! Registration is encouraged at cornerstonegmclanc.org/event/christmasmagic

discovery-d7d5b1907c5a6a67ca8e7e47c43332.description: Create a charming winter scene in this needle felt painting workshop! Using colorful wool fibers and a special felting needle, you'll layer and sculpt wool directly onto fabric stretched in an embroidery hoop to create an adorable winter gnome scene. Suitable for ages 11 to adult, this workshop is a fun introduction to needle felting with a unique twist. All materials and instruction are included! Younger than age 14 must be accompanied by an adult.

discovery-eb4259c60f01034feb6e7c6362a842.description: The Heritage Chorale of Lancaster presents its Winter 2026 concert program: “What Sweeter Music” — based on the work by composer John Rutter. Join us as we celebrate our 32nd year of singing with a program of songs chosen by Artistic Director Barry L. Sawyer, accompanied by pianist Jordan Groh: Ave Maria by Anton Bruckner, Glow by Eric Whitacre, Hodie Christus Natus Est by Luca Marenzio, The Christmas Song by Mel Torme, El Rorro by Jeffrey Van and a host of traditional songs of the season!

occurrences.description: The Heritage Chorale of Lancaster presents its Winter 2026 concert program: “What Sweeter Music” — based on the work by composer John Rutter. discovery-de43499b09ecf9440428ca11046554.title: Jeff Allen at The Junction Center
discovery-de43499b09ecf9440428ca11046554.description: About the Tour: The Love and Laughter Tour Jeff’s show features his brilliant standup comedy, which has garnered hundreds of millions of fans around the globe. There is a part of Jeff’s show where he speaks about his book, Are We There Yet? which tears down all walls and shows Jeff’s journey from very dark times to recovery, restoration, and ultimately redemption. For those inspired by Jeff’s arc, thistour is more than just laughs – it’s about hope, healing, and making a difference. Jeff’s mission statement is Tikkun Olam, a Hebrew phrase meaning “Repairing the World.” His goal is simple: “I want to make a difference that outlives the tour… that outlives me.” Jeff Allen’s Bio Jeff Allen is one of America’s most beloved comedians, with over one billion online views. His rapid-fire humor, which centers on marriage and family, is a hit with all ages. He has appeared everywhere – on Comedy Central, Showtime, TBN, CBN, Family Net, Dry Bar Comedy (their most viewed comedian with seven comedy specials), America’s Got Talent, HBO, Amazon Prime, Huckabee, Pureflix, VH-1, The Today Show, and starred in the films Apostles of Comedy and My 7 Grandmas. He has performed for our troops on aircraft carriers and shipsin the Indian Ocean. Jeff has also performed at three Presidential Inaugural Galas. Millions have seen him across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. But nothing compares to seeing Jeff live. He is presently in pre-production for his new series based on his book, Are We There Yet? Accessible seating is available on the main floor. For questions and accommodations, please contact boxoffice@thejunctioncenter.com or call 717-459-3701 iTickets is the official ticketing provider for this event. To ensure valid entry and receive the most up-to-date event information, all tickets should be purchased through iTickets or by calling The Junction Center directly.

discovery-e75d09141de9226995df2ccb86eb1b.title: You've Still Got a Friend: A Musical Tribute to the Friendship of Carole King & James Taylor
discovery-e75d09141de9226995df2ccb86eb1b.description: This intimate tribute brings to life the enduring bond between Carole King and James Taylor through the songs that defined a generation. Inspired by their legendary Live at the Troubadour performances and album, this concert weaves together the iconic songs and lived-in performances with the emotional history behind the music. Featured songs include classics like “So Far Away,” “Something in the Way She Moves,” “Sweet Baby James” and “I Feel the Earth Move.” Audiences are invited to step into an evening of timeless songwriting that captures the joy, warmth, and soul of a friendship between two legendary artists who changed music forever.

occurrences.description: This intimate tribute brings to life the enduring bond between Carole King and James Taylor through the songs that defined a generation. Inspired by their legendary Live at the Troubadour performances and album, this concert weaves together the iconic songs and lived-in performances with the emotional history behind the music. Featured songs include classics like “So Far Away,” “Something in the Way She Moves,” “Sweet Baby James” and “I Feel the Earth Move.” Audiences are invited to step into an evening of timeless songwriting that captures the joy, warmth, and soul of a friendship between two legendary artists who changed music forever.
occurrences.categories: Music & Dance
occurrences.location: American Music Theatre, 2425 Lincoln Highway East, Lancaster, PA 17602
occurrences.price: Not supplied by this calendar; check event details

discovery-3a97b3be68975af0ce0791329db900.title: KC & The Sunshine Band: Get Down Tonight World Tour 2027
discovery-3a97b3be68975af0ce0791329db900.description: Get ready to dance the night away as KC and The Sunshine Band bring the Get Down Tonight 2027 World Tour to American Music Theatre! Led by Harry Wayne “KC” Casey, the legendary group has spent more than five decades creating the kind of feel-good music that gets audiences out of their seats and onto the dance floor. Formed in 1973, KC and The Sunshine Band helped define the unmistakable “Miami sound,” blending Caribbean influences, R&B, and funk into an infectious style that became a worldwide phenomenon. With more than 100 million records sold worldwide, their extraordinary catalog includes unforgettable hits such as “Get Down Tonight,” “That’s the Way (I Like It),” “Boogie Shoes,” “(Shake, Shake, Shake) Shake Your Booty,” “I’m Your Boogie Man,” and “Please Don’t Go.” The group became the first act since The Beatles to score four No. 1 pop singles within a 12-month period and has earned three GRAMMY Awards, an American Music Award, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. Decades after they first filled dance floors around the world, KC and The Sunshine Band continue to bring their signature combination of funk, disco, irresistible grooves, and pure celebration to audiences everywhere. Come get down tonight with KC and The Sunshine Band on February 5!

discovery-66416564b586c23d07fbd013881e4d.title: Puppy Pals Live – The Action-Packed Comedic Stunt Dog Show
discovery-66416564b586c23d07fbd013881e4d.description: Puppy Pals Live – The Action-Packed Comedic Stunt Dog Show Thursday, February 11 at 7:00 pm Landis Hall at The Junction Center, Manheim As Seen on AMERICA’S GOT TALENT, Puppy Pals Live is a family fun action-packed show where adopted and rescued dogs perform spectacular stunts and breathtaking feats. Watch as Puppy Pals Live leads the puppies and audience through challenging and comical tricks as the pooches show everyone who is really boss! Full of canine stunts and laugh-out-loud canine comedy it is no surprise this show has been a hit all over the USA! Zoe’s House Rescue and Zoe’s House Veterinary Clinic are partnering together to help promote Puppy Pals Live. They provide affordable veterinary care, and help pets find loving forever homes. Meet their team onsite at the event and learn how you can support their lifesaving mission! How you can be a part of the Zoe’s House Family? Zoe’s House Rescue is always in need of more volunteers! Give your time, talents and connections. It’s through volunteers that Zoe’s House Rescue is able to take in more dogs, reach more people, and corporate supports, manage the applications, and get rescues to and from vet visits, intake meetups and events. At Zoe’s House Veterinary Clinic, they believe quality veterinary care should be accessible and affordable for every pet and the people who love them. That’s where Zoe’s House Veterinary Clinic come in! Experienced veterinary team is proud to offer a variety of services, including wellness exams, vaccinations, preventative care, diagnostic testing, bloodwork, sick visits, spay and neuter procedures, dental care, and other surgical services – all while keeping affordability at the heart of what we do. *** Doors: 6:00 pm Showtime: 7:00 pm ***

discovery-b5457735a89fa433141a72ac84ce3f.title: Little River Band with Seals & Crofts 2
discovery-b5457735a89fa433141a72ac84ce3f.description: The Eagles’ founding member, the late Glenn Frey, knew what he was saying when he dubbed Little River Band “the best singing band in the world.” The current lineup of LRB takes that accolade to heart every time they perform. Through the ‘70s and ‘80s, Little River Band enjoyed huge chart success with multi-platinum albums and chart topping hits like “Reminiscing,” “Cool Change,” “Lonesome Loser,” “The Night Owls,” “Take It Easy On Me,” “Happy Anniversary,” “Lady,” and many more! Experience the timeless harmonies and heartfelt storytelling of Seals & Crofts 2 — a tribute and continuation of the iconic musical legacy of the 1970s soft rock duo, Seals & Crofts. Featuring Brady Seals (cousin of Jim Seals and former member of Little Texas) and Lua Crofts (daughter of Dash Crofts), this dynamic duo brings a fresh and soulful interpretation of the original hits that defined a generation. With voices that echo their legendary family ties and a chemistry that captivates audiences of all ages, Seals & Crofts 2 perform beloved classics like “Summer Breeze,” “Diamond Girl,” and “We May Never Pass This Way (Again),” alongside new original music that honors the spirit and sincerity of the originals. More than just a tribute, Seals & Crofts 2 is a celebration of musical heritage, connection, and the enduring power of melody. Don’t miss this enchanting evening filled with nostalgia, harmony, and artistry that bridges generations.

discovery-4978005dbd3071e5da6165fe9c54fd.title: TUSK: The Classic Fleetwood Mac Tribute
discovery-4978005dbd3071e5da6165fe9c54fd.description: Since 2008, TUSK: The Ultimate Fleetwood Mac Tribute has been bringing the music, magic, and unmistakable spirit of Fleetwood Mac to audiences across the country. Exceptional musicianship, authentic vocals, and meticulous attention to detail are at the heart of every TUSK performance—but what truly sets the band apart is something that can’t be rehearsed or manufactured: chemistry, synergy, and intuition. The bond among TUSK’s five founding members spans more than four decades. Long before forming the tribute, they grew up together, became lifelong friends, and spent years making music in original bands, jam groups, and singer-songwriter circles. That shared history has created an instinctive musical connection audiences can feel from the very first note. The result is a performance that goes beyond simply recreating the songs. TUSK captures the emotion, energy, harmonies, and musical interplay that made Fleetwood Mac one of the most beloved bands in rock history. More than a tribute band, TUSK is a family—and every show is a celebration of an extraordinary catalog filled with timeless songs. Experience the music, the memories, and the magic of Fleetwood Mac with TUSK: The Ultimate Fleetwood Mac Tribute.

discovery-70adf1d206814acf4c2695fa2a238e.title: Ricky Skaggs & Kentucky Thunder
discovery-70adf1d206814acf4c2695fa2a238e.description: Experience an evening of exceptional musicianship and timeless American music with Ricky Skaggs & Kentucky Thunder at American Music Theatre! A fifteen-time GRAMMY® Award winner and Country Music Hall of Fame member, Ricky Skaggs has left an enduring mark on both country and bluegrass music. From sharing the stage with Bill Monroe at just six years old to earning 12 No. 1 country hits and the Country Music Association’s Entertainer of the Year award, Skaggs has built a remarkable career while staying true to his musical roots. His celebrated return to bluegrass with Bluegrass Rules! launched a new chapter of GRAMMY® Award-winning recordings alongside Kentucky Thunder. Eight-time recipients of the International Bluegrass Music Association’s Instrumental Group of the Year award, this extraordinary band brings dazzling instrumental work, rich harmonies, and boundless energy to the stage. Join us for a spirited celebration of bluegrass and the musical traditions that continue to inspire one of America’s most respected artists.
